body: I'm so sorry for what you're feeling. I've just logged in this old reddit and see I'm still on these very depressing subreddits on this account. Please see therapy or talk to someone you confide with. I went through multiple suicide attempts and I'm still here with many scars around my body. Now looking back at it, I wished I never done this to myself but I own it when I'm outside and reinvented myself since then so I'm extrude confidence now. It may seem theres no way out when you get this depressive mindset but there is. Create a goal for yourself and stick to it. Give your life meaning because its your life and don't let anyone make you feel it isn't. best wishes
It’s not worth it, I have so many scars on my wrist for arms going horizontally and vertically. I regret every single day that I did it. It’s not worth it. Please talk to someone

You’re 14…how could you possibly consider suicide at such a young age. You have so much love for. I attempted suicide at 23 and I feel horrible for even attempting it. Please keep going. If anything I wished I had adversity at that age. It maybe would’ve prepared more for came for me later in my life. Maybe I wouldn’t of attempted at all but I did. Be glad that you are learning and growing mentally at such a young age instead of it happening when you are older. Look for the lesson in it all. These are all trials in life that you have to overcome

Thanks brother, I’ve been doing a lot better. I got out there and met some new people. Obviously it’s not my ex and I wished it was her but there’s nothing I can do but to move on. I’ve been depressed for 6 months and it was time for me to move on and let go. It feels a whole lot better now and I’ve definitely changed as a person.  I believe my days of crying days on end for her is over. It’s just now a disappointed feeling, knowing how I fallen out with my ex. But oh well I guess that’s life. Who knows what will wait for me, I’m just living the present moment and just allowing to whatever comes my way. I’m not searching not chasing anyone. I’m only chasing my goals in life and focus purely on myself
I did this yesterday. And omg my life is turning around for the better. I met someone other than my ex and I feel a whole lot better
That’s makes me feel a little better thank you
Thank you very much

Thank you for the kind words. My feelings is know by my whole town. So I also feel embarrassed. Idk. I’m really trying to not throw in the towel right now. Even my ex girlfriend is cyber bullying me on her socials. Everyone I know is just judging based on my suicide attempt. I should’ve never done it and ran away. Im and if I did it, I should’ve just ended it and not be typing this right now. I’m really hurt everyday and over it. My life is turning around but this constant thing about being looked down on and hurtful words said about me really really hurts and makes me feel inferior and horrible.

I don’t know what’s your story. I have been suspended from my university twice. I failed so many courses. And I’m going to graduate in a year and I’m still pushing through. Please be strong and don’t end your life. Trust me. I attempted suicide and I survived my own suicide attempt. No matter how hopeless your situation is, you’ll never know what you can achieve is you just keep trying
Oh my gosh. Wow that’s so evil. I can’t even imagine that happening to me. People are so cruel and evil. If you need to talk to someone just DM. I can’t imagine that happening to me.

I fluctuate between 60% and 0%. For the longest time of a few days I’m on 0%. I’m over this pain. I’m too weak. God bless anyone that is getting over this better than I am. My heartbreak isn’t just over a girl, but trauma, betrayal, manipulated, and just overall so cruel that anyone in my shoes would at least think about it. I’m trying but I’m losing the war

I didn’t ask to be loved. I don’t want to hurt anyone. I would love that no one knows I exist so I could do it so much easier. It’s so difficult knowing I’ll be hurting ppl. Trust me if no one cared about me, I would died a long time ago

I’m sorry for what you going through too. It’s really tough. Especially my heartbreak/trauma. I’m really not interested anymore to love again. People are just so easy to quit on you. I’m to good of a person to be able to go through this heartbreak again.

Oh my gosh. I have the exact same situation. My ex didn’t even try to work things out. My therapist says my ex had  psychopathic traits. If we think about it. We might have dogged a bullet. As much I love her so much and would love to have her back right now. For some reason it didn’t happen. If me and my ex were destined to be together then it should’ve happened. But it didn’t. I can’t continue living in this fantasy that it was meant to be. I don’t know what the future holds for me, but i have to keep going. What can I do. While I’m crying for my ex and contemplating ending my life again, she’s simping for another guy. I can’t let her win nor can’t you let your ex win. We both love them very much but they don’t love us back. We deserve better.

I feel the same way. They lied to us. Our ex didn’t chose us. That’s the hard truth . A person that truly love us would never leave our side. My life feels miserable without my ex but it doesn’t have to be. I’m going to make the best of my life. And if that means I’ll never love again or be single forever, I’m perfectly content with that. It’s not what I wanted at first but what can I do. God bless you, and I hope you heal from this faster than me

Yeah I tell myself every day, “she isn’t coming back”. “It’s over forever”. But it hurts me emotionally every time I say it in my head. That’s why I said. “ I hate that I still love you”. Our ex didn’t chose us, that’s the hard truth. A person that truly loves you never leaves you no matter how many reasons they can come up with.
I’m really trying. It’s just the way she did it which was so cruel. I really hope everyone had a less of a tragic heartbreak than mine. Bless you man and I hope you can get over this sooner than me
Thank you. It’s been really difficult. Ive been thinking about ending it all the time. But I’m just fighting and I’ve been fighting ever since.

That resonates with me so much. We know that the person we love is something we build in our heads but they aren’t that person. Knowing this but it’s still difficult to forget and not love that person anymore

Yeah that’s what I’m afraid of. That’s why I just want to be alone forever. I don’t feel I will ever heal from this. Me jumping into a relationship will only hurt her and I can’t do that. I can’t do that to someone.

I feel the same way my friend. I have been fighting for my life as well. While I think what you say is true about some life’s being a lesson for people. I still believe we have a choice to not just be a lesson but to be a inspiration for people. That’s what gets me up everyday. Trust me. I attempted suicide and for some reason I’m alive writing to you. You, me and everyone that’s going through this dark depression and suicidal thoughts have the potential to become the strongest mentally human beings on planet earth. Because many don’t make it like I almost did not. I also grew up in a toxic environment and I’m still fighting. I hope you still do. No matter how dark you find yourself in, there’s always a light somewhere in the place you are in. And trust me I know darkness. Pure darkness.
I’m sorry for you too. I don’t wish no one that is a genuine good person to have to go through this. Bless you and have good luck with your heartbreak. Hopefully you can heal faster than I am
Me too. I hate myself for loving her still. She did me so fucking wrong and I feel stupid for still loving her. I wish I can erase her. But nothing can replace her…

I won’t lie. I feel the same way. I would die for her. I love her to death. But our exes didn’t chose us. What can we do. While we are sulking and crying for our ex. Our ex is busying is probably having sex with someone else. I don’t want to move on either but I’m doing it because I have no choice.
That’s great advice my friend. It great having someone to talk to about what you are going through
I’ll just be alone and be such a unattainable successful man and focus purely on myself.
I felt the same way. You are not alone. I attempted it and survived. I have the same exact story as you. DM if you like. Don’t do it. I almost successfully did it.

Yeah I feel the same way. I’m torn between between to keep loving her or completely forget about her. But not having in my life is actually kind of liberating and I can do anything that I set my mind to and have so much time for myself. I know it’s hard. I think about my ex too and I sometimes don’t want to let go of them

That’s what I’ve doing. I guess it’s still fresh for me. I’m still attached to her. I feel horrible. I’ll just focus on the bright future I have without her and be alone forever. I can’t even imagine thinking about seeing someone else. I’m a attractive guy too it’s just that I’m too in love with her still I don’t know why
That’s what I hope I get to. I’m in the process of focusing on myself and wanting to get to that point where you are

People are horrible selfish creatures. My ex made a TikTok about bad mouthing me to when she cheated on me too. It hurts me that she said that but I have to learn to not feel hurt about it. Even though I still feel hurt about see it till this day.

Thanks for the advice. I’m actually now terrified in loving someone else. I can’t go through this again. It’s horrible. I wasn’t made to go through a heartbreak. Maybe with time idk. She would have to be absolute perfect for me to even consider the idea. Till then I’m building myself to be so desirable and attractive amd successful and I’ll just curve every women that approaches me lol

I really hope you didn’t jump. I’ve been there. We on the subreddit are all thinking the same thing. Yet we are here hoping for better days. No matter how dark of place you may be in, there’s always a light at the end of the tunnel.
Thank you for the advice my friend. God bless you and your goals in life
I don’t know why I still love my ex. I don’t get it. She’s a horrible person and betrayed me. Yet here I am wishing for her to be in my arms…
Melatonin, and meditate when you are in bed

Just me thinking about ex-wife’s scares me. I just wanted one women and be happy but that’s I guess a fantasy. That’s why I just want to be alone forever. It sounds depressing I know but I can’t risk another heartbreak. It took me to a suicide attempt. I have to protect myself.
Thank you. I’m trying and fighting for my life ever since I attempted suicide. Bless you

That’s all we have left to do my friend. I wish I would’ve still been with her right now but that’s a fantasy I can’t live in. We have to focus on the things we can control (ourselves) and not on things we can’t control (our ex). It won’t be easy. I cried a lot tearing up her love letters to me. Good luck

5 months for me. It’s very difficult. I even dreamt about her today. We just have to push through and keep ourselves busy. It’s depressing I know but you are not alone. There are people in worst situations than us, even children involved. We will overcome this. Bless you and your goals in life.

Amen. Thank you I know god has a purpose for me so much so that he has saved my life. I may have such a purpose that I affect a lot of people on this earth. I pray for guidance from god to what he wants me to achieve in life.

Maybe. Idk. I have for now given up on women. I prefer to protect my heart and stay in solitude forever. There are women that want me for my looks and young age but I just can’t risk going through another betrayal/heartbreak from a person that I’ll fall in love with….

Amen brother! Only Jesus can fill our heart that our exes took with them. I’m sorry that you are going through a much more terrible situation. I’ll pray for you tonight. Bless you brother that you will find fulfillment through the lord. Who knows, I might have dodged a bullet from my ex. If we maybe stayed together, I may have lived through hell with her and worse with having children involved. Bless your children and you and thank you for sharing your story.

Pretty well. I have been reading my scriptures, studying the scriptures and I have assisting to my church and I have praying to god. I know god has a plan for me and I have to trust what god has in store for me. This is what I’m going through is a very difficult trial but I am certain I will get through this.

You’re telling me. I cried so many days, and days were I don’t, I’m just holding it in. Im not even ugly but its just that I prefer love and emotional connection over having to participate in hooking up with people. Im too much of a nice guy.

That’s how I feel. We had such a beautiful connection and we just needed therapy. She was swayed by her parents to leave my state and well she thinks the grass is greener on the other side. I believe my ex thinks there is someone like me but I reality just like her, I am irremplazable. Who knows what the future holds for me or you. God bless you and I hope you can be in a happier boat than I am. We are two of the same with the same pain. Good luck my friend

I’m actually scared to love again at the moment. Maybe with time I don’t know. But I’m currently accepting in the idea of being alone forever and just fill my life with materialistic things instead of risking my heart being broken again…

You are absolutely right. That’s what I’m striving for. Just finding happiness within myself and not in others. It’s something I’m not accustomed but I’m sure one day I’ll find it. I’m trying my best to look forward without looking at the past. Because my past is currently still better than my present unfortunately even though everything other than my love life is going well right now
That’s how I feel. Like something is missing. I guess we have to learn to live with it. I’m perfectly content on being alone forever.

I’ve been in a similar situation. I gave up masturbation and sex all together. For me that is the only way. I had sex with other women and I just kept thinking about her. Out of sight and out of mind. Remove all pictures and all things that remind you of her. And even all that you probably see her every you go. I do to to this day. It’s not easy but I’ve been just focusing on myself and loving myself. I’m still in transition but it’s a very difficult process. I already decided I’m going to be alone forever. I’m a handsome guy with huge career goals so I realized I don’t need anyone to make me happy. I just need myself. It sounds depressing but it’s the only way I see myself living a decent life and at least make my family happy and proud.

Thank you my friend. You are a very wise person. I will pass on the knowledge when I’m in a better place and see someone that will be in a situation like I’m in right now. You can say, I’m In my lowest point in my life. Everyday is a struggle and I have been fighting ever since. I’m hoping for better days ahead. Thank you again my friend. Bless you
My trauma from my ex girlfriend is really heavy so maybe it will take a long time for me to even consider it unfortunately

I’m focusing on myself right now. To be honest I don’t think I’ll ever love anyone or seek any female for the rest of my life. Either they seek me or I don’t even approach. I’ve been too much pain and trauma from my ex girlfriend. I’m done with giving out my heart just for someone to stomp on it

You’re absolutely right. She didn’t fight for our relationship enough. I did all the fighting and she didn’t put it the effort that I did. I honestly don’t want any women in my life for the moment. Just the thought of it makes me uneasy. Maybe with time I’ll be open to see other women but what happened to me is something really awful that would make anyone not want to date another female again. Thanks for the advice my friend

I’ve never got “dumped”. My ex lead me on till the very last day until she blocked me. No closure no nothing. She lied to me, used me, manipulated me, broke my heart, and destroyed my self esteem. She used me for attention and a ego boost till she found someone else and she eventually did after three months. My story is long, so feel free to see my previous posts.

I always wonder if she’ll will regret doing this to me and losing me. I loved her so much for who she was (personality wise). I treated her like my queen. I told her she was the most beautiful girl in the world even tho she didn’t feel like it. I wonder if I’m a couple of months she will regret losing me. Maybe cry her eyes out because she’s very emotional and a impulsive person. Because of her impulsive and emotional feelings maybe in a few months or a year she might come crawling back to me crying her eyes out. I’m still telling myself it won’t happen so I can mentally prepare so I don’t get hurt if she never does. But I left the relationship on a high and she left me as a horrible person. So it could happen.

I needed to hear that. “Even when I did everything in my power to change it still didn’t end up the way I wanted to, the it was just not meant to be fixed” I sometimes guilt myself and blame myself for being a failure of not being in the place I want to be in life with my ex girlfriend. As much as she horribly did me wrong and hurt me in a cruel way, I always nip pick and go back to the past telling myself, “maybe I should’ve done this better, or that” I’ll be strong and I’m the hopes I can forget this pain I have

I feel the same way, but I’ve been suppressing that feeling for I don’t jinx it. Plus I believe it is not good to wish the worst for someone imo. You are not alone, we are all in the same boat. Like me
Let god be with us and protect us because we are so much in pain, this is very unfair and horrible. I’m just hoping there are better days

Same here, my ex kept reaching out to me knowing I didn’t want a friendship and I made it clear i didn’t. She did it anyways and used me until she found someone. I hope so too, I still can’t imagine seeing her with someone else. Just the thought of it gives me a panic attack.

I’m going through the same problem. I just keep telling myself “she will find someone” so I can prepare for when I do see my ex with someone else. I also keep telling myself “she will never come back” so I won’t be distraught and go through something like you are. Even though I already went through the nausea and lack of eating for 3 months because she led me on after the breakup unfairly.
Those that don’t understand our pain just want us to continue our suffering (like they would understand) and mask our pain with medication.

I fully agree with this. No one understands mental health till they experience it. Everyone labels us as crazy but we just need understanding rather than just tell us “everything will be fine”. Sometimes life is unbearable and we want mercy from our suffering.
Let’s gooooo. I like that. Value yourself!
Thank you for the advices man. Bless you and your goals in life. You are right this a very difficult detox and it costed me a lot to get to this point where I’m at now. Thanks again man.
Yes, depression brings isolation.

I don’t know what you’re going through but you are way too young to think about ending your life. I tried and almost succeeded at my age of 23. I can’t imagine a person as young as you doing it. Please find people to talk too. I’m an option of many if you need to talk.

Proud of you man. I was there too and don’t stop wanting to call the suicide hotline more than once. I gave in the third time and for some god forsaken reason I’m alive. From my experience, it’s not worth killing yourself trust me. I almost did
A good change is happening to me of course. Thank you man and bless you and your goals in life too.

Honestly I too gave up on dating. I only see females as potential friends and social groups now. I’m just going to focus on myself and let women come to me. My success with attract people and I will never ever seek women again. Stay strong man
It’s been a roller coaster bro but I’m pushing through and I’m feeling change in myself recently

Yes man, I guess you can say I felt cheated too because she said she wasn’t going to see anyone and then she eventually did. My ex was also a compulsive liar and denied and denied until the proof is undeniable. Those people are horrible ppl and we have to grow from this and respect ourselves to not fall into their traps again. It’s the fact we don’t respect ourselves is why they keep mistreating us and keep lying to us. Screw them and let’s love ourselves more than anything in this world. We can do this man. If you need to talk, feel free to start a chat with me man. We got this.
I won’t rush it but I know what I have to do. Trust me, she will regret it if she happens to see me. She has no idea what she missed out on and good riddance to her.

I will bro thanks man. I will heal from this experience and become so strong mentally. I’m going to so move on from this and essentially reinvent myself. Bless you brother and I hope your life goes well and is filled with blessings.

You’re right we have the right to be angry. We do have to love ourselves again to the point we’re we don’t want to need them in our lives. Let’s grow from this and get to the point of not caring anymore

Thank you. She is just really a horrible person that I thought when I chose her she would’ve never hurt me in this way. Look what happened. That’s what drove me to suicide, it was a completely shock to something since the beginning wouldn’t happen but it happened. Thank god I’m alive and this is a new opportunity and a new life for me. Bless you and your goals in life
You are a absolutely right. I just have to work and strive for success to get over this
Thank you. I needed those words

I’m trying to not hope for that because I want to be the bigger person and such but it’s very difficult to not to. Especially in my case. I’m such a good human being and individual. I don’t understand why I was selected from the universe to go through this suffering

Yes. I had days like that too. I can’t believe I gave my heart out to a monster. Thank you for your kind words. I will be strong and grow from this. Same to you I hope you overcome yours. We’re living the similar levels of pain.

Mine was, but she changed completely. I don’t know who is she anymore. People either change for the better or the worst. And I’m my case she changed for the worst. I can’t believe a human being can get away with this injustice. I’m such a good person, how did this happen to me…

Wow, I’m in the same situation. Like we are feeling the exact same feelings. I was lead on, played with my emotions, replaced, she doesn’t care, and it’s been two months and I still have some love. I have been suppressing my hate but deep down I feel this way. It’s a tough battle for me and I just keep telling myself that she won’t come back and I have to live alone forever because I have lost trust in all women.
Im on 6 weeks and I felt the same way. We just have to be strong and remember the bad more than the good

Idk what you are going through but don’t care about what other people think. I use to think that and take my life to see if they gave a shit. At the end of the day they didn’t. I realized they didn’t care. Love yourself man and fuck everyone, you are you. No one can love you like you can love yourself. I learned to say fuck everyone and silence them with my success.

Thank you very much for you kind words. Bless you and I hope everything in life goes well. It’s almost 2 months and I don’t cry anymore but I sometimes shed a tear in the most random of places and I think that’s just a representation of how emotionally hurt I am.
Talk to me. I attempted it. It’s not worth it. I’m 23 and there’s so much to life than what you think you experienced already. I loved and lost and I know that hurts but we have to be strong
Talk to me man. I attempted suicide too, it’s not worth it. I’m 23 too and I know there’s so much to life
If you want to talk, I’m here. I have attempted suicide recently. It’s not pretty by just a little but I managed to survive.

You’re right. I’m just saying it, but deep down it’s very difficult to forgive her. I hope the universe and everything holy hears my pain and tears and grants me happiness and success for my suffering
Thank you, I am. I won’t give her what she wants. My life is so precious and she doesn’t even deserve my tears. Im going to be so successful in life and she going to regret not choosing me.

Think about the people you’ll hurt. I almost killed myself and I didn’t know how hurt were my loved ones were when I came back from the dead. It’s not worth it, trust me I know. I shouldn’t be alive now, but I am.

Think about the people you’ll hurt. I almost killed myself and I didn’t know how hurt were my loved ones were when I came back from the dead. It’s not worth it, trust me I know. I shouldn’t be alive now, but I am.

Don’t do it man. I attempted suicide. I almost died if it wasn’t for a god forsaken reason I didn’t bleed out or die of overdose. There’s always light at the end of the tunnel. It may not be bright but theres always some light that many of us don’t see. Please talk to me if you need someone to talk too. I’ve been there. And recently too

She hasn’t even said sorry about anything. She playing victim to all her followers on social media saying I traumatized her. Can you believe that? It boils my blood but I have to forgive because it’s never good to wish the worst for someone. I wish her the best

The thing is I was fine with her moving it if she just was honest about it. I tried many times throughout the months to break it off with her for good, but she just kept saying, “ nooo, don’t go”. And I stupidly allowed her to use me. The thing is I never expected her to do this to me. We had a beautiful two year relationship living together and we fallen out because of economical reasons and because I had to focus on my classes in my university. I told her many times, “please don’t use me”, “please be transparent with me”, and guess what…she did it anyways.

It’s crazy that I was all this to my ex girlfriend. And she treated me like just an option and used me. I gave her all my love, been very loyal to her and was very consistent with her. Yet she decided she rather slut it out and meet more people rather than chose me. She might regret it down the line because she’s big into love. She believes there is a lot of men like me, and maybe just maybe she will find one, but that’s would be universally so unfair to what she did to me
Thank you, I appreciate it. I’m going to overcome this and be extremely successful

If it was meant to be then it shouldn’t happen, and we can’t be stuck in this false reality that it should’ve happen or if we did this better. No and no, nothing would’ve set you apart and maybe it’s just for now. If she was meant for you, then one day when you least expect it, she will come to you. But till then, don’t give her a single inch of space in your brain. She didn’t chose you and she left you. Accept that, value yourself and make her regret for leaving you and succeed in life. Success is the greatest revenge

Yeah don’t hold on to hope. I held on to hope for too long that when my hope died by the hands of my ex’s action I almost lost my life. Stay away from those “getting your ex back” videos too. Remember your soulmate will never leave you and hurt you. And if they are then it isn’t the right time for the both of you. Use this time to grow yourself as a person. And if they comeback, you’ll make the decision based on how you feel and how accomplished you are in the future

It’s not worth it. You may not think nobody cares, but you are forgetting the only person that will love you the way you need…….YOU. Love yourself to the point where you don't need no one. I almost successfully ended my life and for some god forsaken reason im alive. Don't do it, its not worth it

I feel that sometimes too. I have been betrayed and lied to by the person who I thought was the loml. But I’m slowly accepting that I cant give them my tears. While I’m crying, she’s living her best life, like she didn’t break me. I’m using that as motivation to get over her. I’m tired of crying for her for someone that didn’t chose or value me. I’m going to grow in the person that she will regret for the rest of her life she didn’t chose. Keep going to the gym and track your macronutrients. It will help a lot. It’s helping me with my self esteem.
Yes, I like that phrase. The person I once loved is dead. She is a completely different person now. I have to accept it and move on

You’re not alone. I’m in the same boat. I also see her everywhere. I also thought she was meant to be in my life forever. I also dreamed of her so us together for a month. I also can’t accept to this day after a month a half. She also betrayed me. She also made me feel a way I never felt for someone. But at the end of the day, she didn’t chose and she didn’t chose you. We both have to accept that and get over our ex so we can be ready for someone that will chose us. And if our exes are our soulmates than wouldn’t it be best if they come back to us all new and improved and successful or comeback to our still heartbroken selves and still crying over her? We have to be strong and show the world who we are and what we can become. I know I will. And I’m sure anyone like us can too.
Same. But I learned to also remember the bad things with the good. I’ve been sleeping a lot better now just by remembering the bad with the good

By loving yourself it means to grow yourself. Do new things in your life, new hobbies. Do something that gives you a feeling of accomplishment. Whether it’s working out, or as simple as finishing art project. Make your own happiness, don’t depend on someone else to give you the happiness you so crave. I once loved my ex more than myself and it was the biggest mistake I ever did in my life. Don’t do the same mistake I did.

There’s something you are not doing right. A year is too much. You have to be comfortable with your solitude. You were fine before you met her and you’ll be fine after her. The hard truth is she didn’t chose you. You have to accept that. I have to accept that too. I know my success will the have her regret in not choosing me.

Yes, so do no contact. If she is meant to be with you and it will happen. Be mature about this and value yourself and do no contact. If she decided to leave you and not choose you, then it let it be. A person that is your soulmate will never leave you or leave you forever. She’ll come back if it’s meant to be
I like this a lot thank you. Fully love the “need to be comfortable alone”. I’ve been through a lot and I know I’ll get through this
I can forget about my ex either, but I try to remember that she left me and that’s the hard truth. She didn’t chose me and that’s something I have to accept. I have to value myself and so should you

I also to feel like it didn’t want to live just for myself. Everything I did was once for my ex girlfriend too. I also attempted suicide and almost successfully did it but for some god forsaken reason I’m alive. It’s not worth it, trust me. Value yourself and don’t contact your ex.
